algorithm.likelihood: sum of completion UTF-8 byte and EOS log probabilities, prompt targets masked; recurrent gradients still propagate through the conditioning prompt
algorithm.optimizer: plain float64 SGD with one global gradient norm clip per governed preference pair
algorithm.reference: full frozen weights from an existing completed single-worker native neural training run in the same training/dataset authority
algorithm.ordering: epochs and registered preference documents in exact order, hidden state reset for each chosen/rejected sequence
algorithm.randomness: no stochastic updates, dropout, shuffling, reward sampling or scalar reward-to-weight fabrication

data.representation: canonical JSON preference documents in the exact registered materialized dataset train split
data.authority: existing DatasetRegistry quality, materialized bytes, training rights and dataset authority epoch
data.preference_source: explicit chosen/rejected text; no acceptance of scalar reward-only records

lineage.experiment: PostTrainingExperiment binds preference dataset, parent model, exact objective/algorithm/configuration and planned evaluation suite; candidate-only evidence
lineage.parent: manifest/base model, full parent checkpoint, immutable parent execution binding and live parent dataset authority are checked before updates, checkpoint commits and artifact reload
lineage.candidate: distinct run/model identity; frozen reference unchanged; no production registry or promotion write

persistence.authority: existing TrainingRepository execution binding and checkpoint/payload tables
persistence.full_state: policy/reference weights, optimizer, exact pair/epoch cursor, cumulative usage, initial/final loss and chosen/rejected margin observations, experiment and parent identity
persistence.commit: one complete pair update and full payload in existing current-worker-fenced transaction, serialized against preference and parent dataset authority changes
persistence.recovery: validate all model/schema/config/parent/pair identities, advance worker epoch, resume exact next pair; finished checkpoint terminalizes without another update

usage_scope: training usage includes all four policy/reference likelihood passes per pair update plus initial and final objective observations; repeated read-only admission/reload validation recomputations are outside this training counter and no total lifetime compute accounting is claimed
failure_rules: training and restore require a distinct single-worker candidate; the registered native neural parent must itself be single-worker before its weights can be loaded
unmaterialized, reordered, substituted or revoked preference documents fail before model work
parent checkpoint/config/model/code/environment or live authority drift fails closed
unknown payload/binding fields, nonfinite weights/objective/gradients and cumulative usage tampering prevent resume
stale workers cannot checkpoint, emit telemetry or complete replacement work
restart preserves cumulative budgets and exact full numerical state
candidate comparisons and experiment lineage never grant production promotion
scope_limitations: bounded local byte-level recurrent DPO experiment
single native neural parent and worker
same existing dataset and training stores
fresh database checkpoint recovery requires the exact native neural parent to be restored and completed before its preference candidate
no on-policy RL environment optimization claim
no production promotion, masterplan closure or signoff
